window-1.title: Below the Surface — Flippo disk (1995)
window-1.blurb: A 1995 crisp-packet pog dredged from the Amstel and catalogued as seriously as a medieval coin — scroll the whole gorgeous river-mud archive, then start building and remixing your own display case, because you will not be able to stop at one object.

window-2.title: Strictly Sweden — the strict list
window-2.blurb: Denna curates like you do — obsessively specific, zero filler — and this fresh Sweden deep-dive is basically a side quest itinerary waiting for you to claim it.

window-3.title: Shirley Temple (with real grenadine)
window-3.blurb: The most gloriously kitsch drink ever invented, made with actual pomegranate grenadine instead of the radioactive stuff — pure diner-counter nostalgia that deserves a flash photo and three cherries.

window-4.title: 10 Ceramic Table Lamps from Contemporary Pottery Studios
window-4.blurb: One lumpy, hand-thrown ceramic lamp does more for a room than a whole furniture haul, and knowing you, you'll look at these and immediately start googling pottery classes so you can make your own.

window-5.title: Kuro Kare, Havelock II
window-5.blurb: An 18-seat basement hideout where two ex-fine-dining chefs spend 36 hours on one pot of black curry — that level of unhinged commitment to a single bit is so completely your language, and the off-menu rotation means there's always a reason to go back.
